dialogs.mfa.off_turn_it_on_and: Off. Turn it on and signing in takes your password and a six-digit code from an authenticator app on your phone, so a stolen password alone gets nobody in.
dialogs.mfa.scan_this_with_your_authenti: Scan this with your authenticator app, then type the code it shows.
dialogs.mfa.cant_scan_enter_this_key: Can't scan? Enter this key by hand, as a time-based code:

dialogs.mfa.on_turning_it_off_takes: On. Turning it off takes a code from your phone, so a session left open on a shared screen is not enough to strip it off your account.
dialogs.nodedialog.optional_json_schemas: Optional JSON Schemas over the whole message, so the payload is properties.payload. A wire between two typed ends that can never agree is refused at deploy; anything else that breaks a schema goes to a Catch node with the path of the bad field.
dialogs.propfield.this_flow_file_has_no: This flow file has no FlowLab diagram to pick yet. Add one from the tab bar first.
dialogs.rollback.why_this_goes_in_the: Why? This goes in the deployment log.

dialogs.subflowprops.instances_on_flows_: Instances on flows follow when this changes.

dialogs.wireprobe.break_pause_when_a_val: Break: pause when a value is put on this wire
dialogs.wireprobe.values_this_wire_carri: Values this wire carried, newest last.
dialogs.wireprops.while_the_target_keeps: While the target keeps up, nothing is written. When it stops taking messages, this wire holds them on disk in order, and delivers them when it comes back, even across a restart.
dialogs.wireprops.give_up_on_a_message: Give up on a message after this many tries
dialogs.wireprops.blank_keeps_trying_one: Blank keeps trying one message for as long as the target refuses it, and nothing behind it is delivered. With a number, a message refused that many times goes to a Catch node as an error with the message attached, and the wire moves on.
